item.title: Over 7,000 elderly patients in care homes receive their Christmas gifts
item.description: The measure is described as a key part of government’s commitment to providing holistic care, which ensures that the social and emotional needs of the elderly are also met

item.title: Malita Investments says it has found funding needed for Luqa social housing project
item.description: The Luqa social housing project was suspended following significant financial trouble Malita Investments experienced

item.title: Alex Borg calls for unity and respect in first Christmas message as Opposition leader
item.description: Opposition leader Alex Borg used his first Christmas message as head of the Nationalist Party to call for unity, respect and a move away from partisan politics

item.title: Archbishop warns of detachment through social media, AI misinformation
item.description: Archbishop Charles Scicluna expresses concern regarding the emergence of AI and the potential for mass misinformation

item.title: Christians the world over are celebrating Christmas
item.description: Malta joins Christmas celebrations as Caritas hosts people who are alone for lunch • Christmas celebrated amid geo-political tensions

item.title: Renowned actress Marylou Coppini dies
item.description: Throughout her career, Marylou became a household name as an actress and theatre practitioner known for her work in stage, television, and film within the performing arts scene

item.title: Unlicensed driver handed six-month prison sentence after being caught fleeing road police
item.description: The police said that despite being warned not to drive again, he completely ignored them and drove the vehicle out of the police garage himself

item.title: The sweetness of Malta depends on the sweetness of our hearts, Archbishop says in Midnight Mass
item.description: Archbishop Charles Scicluna says Maltese society remains one in which mutual kindness is valued but urged that this should be lived not only in Malta’s international role as a promoter of peace in the Mediterranean, but also within communities and families

item.title: US airstrikes hit Islamic State targets in Nigeria
item.description: US President Donald Trump announces ‘powerful and deadly’ airstrikes against Islamic militants in Nigeria

item.title: Archaeological assessment for Qrendi site delayed until after zoning approval
item.description: The Superintendence for Cultural Heritage has delayed a full archaeological assessment of the land behind Qrendi Primary School until after planning parameters are approved for a pending zoning application
